opening.evidence: game_start fruitful_start_effect (common/scripted_effects/01_start_of_game_effects.txt:7) fires origin.7000 after 1800+0-1800 days (events/origin_events_5.txt:14-54), which enables TIYANKIS_PROJECT (common/special_projects/00_projects_plantoids.txt:106 -> 7005). Mechanics hooks: on_planet_bombarded (7200/7201), on_monthly_pulse_country (7300 lures critters), on_fleet_enter_orbit (7303), on_entering_system_fleet (7302/7310), on_colonization_started common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1277-1278 (7326/7328), on_resolution_passed :4361-4362, on_war_beginning :2617.

note.zh: 保护法案（7500）或害虫防治法案（7510）。
种子的主人不同：他国殖民（7326）或自己殖民（7328）。
note.en: Depends on who colonises: another empire (7326) or the seed owner (7328).

notes.zh: 本起源的主线很短（天基生物观察）；其余内容是由玩法状态（喂食、种子、战争、议案）触发的独立事件。
notes.en: The scripted story is short (the Tiyanki study); the rest are independent events fired by gameplay state (feeding, seeds, war, resolutions).

uncertain: The seed mechanics events (7200-7325, mostly hidden) were read for their hooks only; 7311 fires garden.critters events of the Plantoid garden content, not part of this origin.
